title: Foulmouthed
summary: FOUL'MOUTHED, adjective Using language scurrilous, opprobrious, obscene or profane; uttering abuse, or profane or obscene words; accustomed to use bad language. So foulmouthed a witness never appeared

inlines.v: FOUL'MOUTHED, adjective Using language scurrilous, opprobrious, obscene or profane; uttering abuse, or profane or obscene words; accustomed to use bad language. So foulmouthed a witness never appeared in any cause.
